dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000px0a](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000px0a) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 47.242 depth occurred on Mar 05 2025 64km SE of Salina Cruz. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 15.7639 longitude -94.7967. It impacted 4 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
